description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LDAPDaoTest' for testing the LDAP Data Access Object (LDAPDao) in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to verify LDAP user retrieval, employee data fetching, LDAP sync status, and LDAP provider retrieval. The class uses fixtures for setup and contains multiple test cases for different LDAP-related operations.

classes.name: LDAPDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case class for LDAPDao related functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by loading fixture data for LDAP DAO tests.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers associated with multiple users.

methods.name: testGetNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of non-local users by username, including cases for non-existing, disabled, local, LDAP, and non-LDAP users.

methods.name: testGetUserByUsername
methods.description: Tests retrieval of users by username with various user status and authentication methods.

methods.name: testGetEmployee
methods.description: Tests fetching employee details via different search filters, including exception handling for non-unique results.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of LDAP auth provider details by user unique ID.

methods.name: testGetAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Tests fetching all LDAP authentication providers.

methods.name: testSaveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Tests saving LDAP synchronization status and verifies the stored data.

methods.name: testGetLastLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the most recent LDAP synchronization status.
